original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it.

first_step.inspect: Read Model section 1 of the three-register bound and identify the exact excluded free operations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write a complete operation alphabet outside one named premise and price a baseline before searching identities.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.

actual_scope: In F2[C7 semidirect C3] on three registers, determine whether the diagonal conjugacy-orbit target diag([a],[a^2],[a^4]) has a two-call word when every nonidentity group element and every rank-one idempotent in M3(F2) is a paid call.
scope_change_reason: The card is refined to one exact nonabelian address group of order 21, one three-register target orbit and the complete 560-operation alphabet. This changes the abelian additive address hypothesis and fixes a bounded target/domain rather than repeating the three-register rational-frame theorem.
bottleneck_link: A two-call realization would lower the paid-call bill from the direct three-call baseline in a precisely specified nonabelian register model; the exact exclusion identifies a scoped limit on this sharing route.
stop_rule: Exhaust all words of length 0, 1 and 2 in the complete 560-operation alphabet for the target, verify the direct three-call witness and a two-call positive control, and stop. Do not expand to other groups, targets or register widths this cycle.
evidence: verify.py checks the order-21 group law and all 28 rank-one idempotents, verifies the direct three-call target word and a positive two-call control, then compares every one-call and all 313,600 ordered two-call products coefficientwise in F2[G]. It excludes every word through length two for the conjugacy-orbit target. The result is limited to this group, alphabet and endpoint.

open_questions.why_it_matters: A four-register construction could expose sharing that this three-register target cannot support.
open_questions.first_step: Enumerate the rank-one idempotents in M4(F2), choose one exact four-entry target and compute the fully charged short-word budget before searching.
open_questions.blocked_by: That is a different register count and search domain, deliberately outside this bounded cycle.
